tags.name: code-color
tags.description: Syntax highlighting that never touches your markup.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: `js`, `css`, or `html` (plus aliases like `javascript`, `ts`, `json`, `xml`). Default: a `language-*` class on a `<code>` inside, else `html`.

tags.name: code-editor
tags.description:
A syntax-highlighted code field that works like a textarea.

Events: `change`, `input`

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Default value (what `form.reset()` restores). Without it, the element's initial text content is the default: a `<textarea>`'s, a `<pre>`'s, or its own.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: `js`, `css`, or `html` (plus aliases like `javascript`, `ts`, `json`, `xml`), as for code-color. Default: a `language-*` class on a `<code>` in the initial markup, else `html`.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown while the value is empty.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Also inherited from a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The value can be selected and copied but not edited. Tab then moves focus as usual.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid while the value is empty.

attributes.name: tab-size
attributes.description: Spaces per indent level, for Tab/Shift+Tab, auto-indent, and how tab characters display. Default 2.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Minimum height in lines (sets `--domkit-code-editor-rows`). The editor grows with its content; cap it with CSS `max-height`.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: `soft` (or empty) wraps long lines; `off` (the default) scrolls them horizontally.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the form.

attributes.name: no-auto-close
attributes.description: Don't auto-close brackets and quotes (also turns off typing over a closer and deleting an empty pair).

tags.name: attribute-cycler
tags.description:
A persisted attribute or class switch (e.g. a theme toggle) driven by buttons.

Events: `change`

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Comma-separated values to cycle through. An empty entry means "none": no class, or no attribute.

attributes.name: attribute
attributes.description: The attribute to set on the targets. Default `class`, where the value is one class among the target's others; any other attribute gets the value as its whole value.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Selector for the element(s) whose attribute is set. Default `html`.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: localStorage key to persist under. Without it, the value isn't persisted.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value. Reflects; set it to choose the initial value when nothing is stored.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Its buttons are disabled, and invoker commands are ignored.

tags.name: define-component
tags.description:
Register a custom element in HTML, from a module or from inline markup.

Events: `load`, `error`

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The tag name to register.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a module exporting the element class, resolved against the document's base URL. Not allowed with inline markup.

attributes.name: import
attributes.description: With `src`: the name of the export to register. Default `default`.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Inline markup, if there's no `<template>` child. Not allowed with `src`.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: With inline markup: `open` (default) or `closed` shadow root, or `none` to append the markup as light DOM.

tags.name: polyfill-window
tags.description:
Load a module's export onto window, in HTML.

Events: `error`, `load`

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The global to assign (`window[name]`).

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of the module, resolved against the document's base URL.

attributes.name: import
attributes.description: Name of the export to assign. Default `default`.

tags.name: draw-svg
tags.description:
Self-drawing SVG strokes, CSP-safe and reduced-motion aware.

Events: `play`, `pause`, `ended`

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How long each shape takes to draw: `2s`, `400ms`, or milliseconds. Default `2s`.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Wait before the first shape starts. Default `0`.

attributes.name: stagger
attributes.description: Extra delay for each next shape, so they draw one after another. Default `0` (together).

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description: A CSS easing function. Default `ease-in-out`.

attributes.name: iterations
attributes.description: How many times to draw: a number or `infinite`. Default `1`.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: `normal`, `reverse`, `alternate`, or `alternate-reverse`, as in CSS animations.

attributes.name: erase
attributes.description: After drawing in, keep going until the stroke has wiped itself out from its start.

attributes.name: select
attributes.description: Which shapes to animate, as a selector. Default: every path, line, polyline, polygon, circle, ellipse, and rect.

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Whether it's paused. Reflects; write it in markup to start paused (strokes hidden).

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: `visible`: wait to play until the drawing scrolls into view. Default: play on connect.

tags.name: drill-menu
tags.description:
A list that drills into sub-screens and back.

Events: `push`, `pop`

attributes.name: screen
attributes.description: Key of the screen currently shown (absent = the list). Reflects; set it to navigate.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Items can't be activated, leave the tab order, and are marked aria-disabled. `push()`/`pop()` still work from script.

attributes.name: sync-hash
attributes.description: Mirror the current screen in `location.hash`, so links and the browser's Back button work.

tags.name: frame-timer
tags.description:
A frame-paced ticking clock with play/pause.

Events: `play`, `pause`, `tick`

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Whether the timer is paused. Reflects; write it in markup to start paused.

attributes.name: fps
attributes.description: Ticks per second. Default 60. Any positive number up to the display's refresh rate.

tags.name: gamepad-input
tags.description:
Game controller buttons that send invoker commands.

Events: `gamepadpress`

attributes.name: commandfor
attributes.description: The id of the element to send commands to. Without it, `--custom` commands bubble up from this element as `command` events, for an ancestor to handle.

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Which controller (0 is the first connected). Default: any.

attributes.name: up
attributes.description: The command for the d-pad (or left stick) up. Likewise `down`, `left`, and `right`.

attributes.name: a
attributes.description: The command for the bottom face button. Likewise `b` (right), `x` (left), `y` (top), `lb`, `rb`, `lt`, `rt`, `select`, `start`, `ls`, `rs`, and `home`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Button presses do nothing.

tags.name: hot-key
tags.description: Toggle a native dialog or popover, or run an invoker command, with a keyboard shortcut.

attributes.name: hotkey
attributes.description: One or more space-separated shortcuts, e.g. `mod+k /`. `mod` is ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere.

attributes.name: commandfor
attributes.description: The id of an element to send `command` to, as on a `<button>`. Without it, a `--custom` command bubbles up from this element as a `command` event (for an ancestor to handle), and with no command the shortcut toggles the `<dialog>` or popover inside.

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: With `commandfor`: the command to run, a built-in one (`show-modal`, `close`, `request-close`, `show-popover`, `hide-popover`, `toggle-popover`) or a custom `--name` (dispatched as a `command` event).

attributes.name: non-modal
attributes.description: Open a dialog with `show()` instead of `showModal()`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The shortcut does nothing. The dialog or popover itself is unaffected.

tags.name: infinite-combo-box
tags.description:
An accessible autocomplete with paged ("infinite") results.

Events: `error`, `input`, `change`, `toggle`

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder for the input.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Also inherited from a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until there's a value.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the option list is showing. Reflects.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial value (the value of an option, or text with `allow-custom`).

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL template for remote options: `{query}` and `{cursor}` are replaced (missing ones are added as `?q=`/`?cursor=`). JSON (an array, or `{ options, next, total }`) or HTML (with an optional `data-next` element).

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Render the list in normal flow under the input, instead of as a floating popup in the top layer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the form.

attributes.name: debounce
attributes.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before searching. Default 0 for local options, 200 for `src`/`searchFunction`.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Show the element's own matching options this many at a time, loading more as the list scrolls.

attributes.name: min-length
attributes.description: Characters needed before searching. Default 0.

attributes.name: allow-custom
attributes.description: Typed text is a valid value even if it matches no option.

tags.name: attribute-provider
tags.description:
Add classes, styles, and attributes to children by media query.

Events: `change`

attributes.name: classes
attributes.description: `[media query] class class | …` sections. Bracket-less sections always apply.

attributes.name: styles
attributes.description: `[media query] property: value; … | …` sections.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: `[media query] name=value; name; name=null | …` sections. `null` removes the attribute while the query matches.

attributes.name: container
attributes.description: Container mode: evaluate the queries against an element's size instead of the viewport. Empty = the parent element; otherwise a selector for the closest matching ancestor.

tags.name: query-container
tags.description:
Swap the element wrapping some content by media query.

Events: `change`

attributes.name: default
attributes.description: Wrapper when no query matches, as a simple selector (`ul`, `ol.steps`, `div#x[data-y=z]`). Defaults to the first section's.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: `[media query] selector` sections separated by `|`. The last matching section wins.

attributes.name: container
attributes.description: Container mode: evaluate the queries against an element's size instead of the viewport. Empty = the parent element; otherwise a selector for the closest matching ancestor.

tags.name: stylable-select
tags.description:
A fully stylable listbox that works like a native select.

Events: `input`, `change`

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Also inherited from a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until an option is selected.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow selecting more than one option.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Number of visible rows (sets `--domkit-select-size`, used by index.css).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the form.

tags.name: swipe-input
tags.description:
Swipe gestures that send invoker commands.

Events: `swipe`

attributes.name: commandfor
attributes.description: The id of the element to send commands to. Without it, `--custom` commands bubble up from this element as `command` events, for an ancestor to handle.

attributes.name: up
attributes.description: The command for a swipe up (for example `--up`, or a built-in like `show-popover`).

attributes.name: down
attributes.description: The command for a swipe down.

attributes.name: left
attributes.description: The command for a swipe left.

attributes.name: right
attributes.description: The command for a swipe right.

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: How far, in CSS pixels, a pointer must travel to count as a swipe. Default 30.

attributes.name: pointers
attributes.description: Which pointers swipe: `touch`, `pen`, `mouse`, or a space-separated mix. Default: all of them.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Swipes do nothing.

tags.name: tabbed-ui
tags.description:
Accessible tabs and panels from plain children.

Events: `change`

attributes.name: selected-index
attributes.description: Index of the selected tab. Reflects the current selection.

attributes.name: manual
attributes.description: Arrow keys move focus only; Enter/Space selects (manual activation).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: No tab can be selected by the user (or by commands), and the tabs leave the tab order. Panels stay as they are.
